resources.string: Sign in again to view your account.
These preferences apply to all accounts on this device. They are not synchronized to other devices.

Signing out removes this account’s credentials, local records, queued operations, and downloads from this device. Unsynchronized content may be lost. Other devices are unaffected. Local sign-out also works offline; if server revocation cannot be confirmed, it will be reported separately. Continue?
Only your display name can be changed here. Your username, school, and role cannot be edited.

Use a new password of 8–128 characters, different from your current password. If two-factor authentication is enabled, enter a verification or recovery code. You must sign in again after a successful change.
Verification or recovery code, if enabled
Leave blank if two-factor authentication is not enabled. Passwords and codes are never saved as local drafts.
Change your password? After successful server verification, existing credentials are revoked and all devices must sign in again. A failed request is not reported as a successful change.
The server changed your password. Sign in again.
These are this account’s Android grants returned by the server. Revoked or expired credentials cannot be used. The server lists up to 100 unexpired device grants.
The server returned no signed-in devices.
Revoke the credentials for “%1$s”? That device must sign in again. Revocation is reported only after server confirmation.
“%1$s” is the current device. After successful revocation, you must sign in again here. Unsynchronized content is not submitted by this action. Continue?

Account deletion cannot be undone. The server verifies your password and any required second factor, then processes erasure of the account and associated data. Local account data is cleared only after the server acknowledges the request.
Export important data and finish synchronization first. An accepted request that is still processing does not mean all data has been erased.
I understand that my account cannot be restored and unsynchronized data may be lost.

Final confirmation: request permanent deletion of this account? After the server verifies and accepts the request, this device signs out and clears local account data. If erasure is still processing, only acceptance is reported, not completed erasure.

Read all pages provided by the account export API, including this account’s local records, synchronization receipts, and download metadata. Login credentials are excluded. Downloaded file contents are not included in the JSON.
An internet connection and a working export API are required. A single export file is limited to 50 MiB. Oversized or failed exports report an error rather than produce partial data.

This export contains learning content and personal data. It is first stored only in private app cache. You can then choose where to save it or whom to share it with. Read your server and local account data?
The file is ready in private app cache. It has not been saved externally or sent.
Private temporary files are removed when this account signs out or the screen instance is released. Copies you save or share must be managed separately.
The file may contain personal and learning data. Android will let you select a receiving app, which can keep a copy. Opening the sharing panel does not mean the file has been sent. Continue?
The file was written to your chosen destination.

This version has no confirmed mobile feedback submission API or receipt contract, so it cannot submit to the server. Save a local draft or export a file, then submit it yourself through a known support channel. This page never claims that it was sent.

Screenshot upload is also disabled. Restricted private storage, upload receipts, owner-only access, and size/format rules still need integration. Never include passwords or verification codes in feedback.
Problem, steps to reproduce, and expected result
%1$d / 10000 characters. Remove private information and sensitive credentials first.
A local draft available only to this account instance. Not sent.
The draft was saved locally for this account. It was not sent to the server.

PhysicsOS feedback draft. This file was exported by the user on their device and has not been submitted through the app. Choose a trusted support channel to send it. Do not include passwords, verification codes, or login credentials.

Only this account’s persistent operations and actual receipts are shown. A finished sync attempt does not mean conflicts or failures have been resolved. Request bodies and private server error messages are not displayed.

Conflicts never overwrite server data automatically. Return to the relevant learning record, experiment, or class page to compare and merge versions. Here you can only explicitly discard the queued operation.
This account has no synchronization records.
Records shown: %1$d / %2$d (newest first). All receipts are included in the account export.
Retry with the original operation key
This operation will no longer be synchronized. Changes not yet uploaded may be lost. This does not roll back anything the server has already accepted. Discard it?
Remove only this device’s confirmed receipt? This does not undo or delete server content.
This synchronization attempt ended. Check each item’s actual state; unresolved conflicts and failures remain.
The local queue record was removed. Server content was not rolled back.
Text size and font scaling follow Android system settings.
Allow background sync on metered networks
When off, background sync waits for an unmetered network. Manually choosing to sync now still uses your current network and may incur data charges.
Your session expired or needs reauthentication. Sign in again before continuing.
The account changed. This operation did not continue in the new account.
The server result could not be confirmed. Check your connection. Verify the state before retrying sensitive operations; do not assume success.
The required mobile API is not ready or the service is unavailable. Server integration is required. Success has not been reported.
The server denied this operation. Check account permissions or security verification requirements.
The password or second-factor code is incorrect. Check and try again.
Two-factor authentication is enabled. Enter a valid verification or recovery code.
Too many attempts. Try again later.
Enter a display name of 1–32 characters without control characters.
The current password is required. Use a new password of 8–128 characters, different from the current one.
The new passwords do not match.
A verification or recovery code must contain 6–64 non-whitespace characters.
Type uppercase DELETE exactly and confirm deletion.
The server response does not match the mobile account contract. The result is unconfirmed and needs server integration testing.
Device data could not be read or saved. Check available storage and try again.
The data exceeds the safe export size. No partial file was generated. Contact support for a section-by-section export.
Prohibited credentials or private paths were found in the export. No file was created. Contact support to check the export API.
The temporary export is no longer available. Generate it again.
A file saving or sharing app could not be opened. Check that a compatible app is installed.
Enter 1–10000 characters of feedback without invalid control characters.
Resolve the conflict or wait for the in-flight request first. Data was not overwritten automatically.
Completion could not be confirmed. Retry or contact support. An unknown result is never reported as success.
